body: BloodHound Lil Jeff, Born Jeffery Harris, Was A Chicago Drill Rapper Who Built A Strong Following Through His Music And His Connection To The BloodHound Circle. He Was Known For His Close Relationship With BloodHound Q50, Who Considered Him More Like A Brother Than A Cousin. Jeff Was Tragically Killed In Chicago On June 8, 2024, At Just 21 Years Old. His Music And Legacy Have Continued To Live On Through His Fans, His Collaborators And The BloodHound Movement.
